title: NIVA: Numerical Islet Viability Assay Image Processing using OpenCV for LIVE/DEAD Viability/Cytotoxicity kit with Laser Scanning Microscopy
protocol: Set up channels in ZEN with the wavelength values of the fluorescence dye.
Activate the ‘Z-stack’ checkbox in the Acquisition dimensions.
Select ‘Z-stack tool’ in the Multidimensional Acquisition tool group.
Open the Z-stack tool.
Set all values in the tool.
Click Start Auto Configuration.
Click on the Start Experiment button to start the experiment.
Set live-channel with green color and dead-channel with red color.
Move to Processing tab on the category.
Find Orthogonal Projection and click on it.
Change Method Parameters tab to Average for general projection view.
Click Max/Min button in Display window under the image overview.
Export the image in proper format.
Run NIVA.exe on your computer.
Load your image into the program using supported formats: jpg, jpeg, bmp, png, tif, or tiff.
Increase LowL value in the trackbar within the Values groupbox to blur and threshold the image.
Observe the real-time changes in the loaded image as you adjust the LowL value.
Identify the gray-colored contours that represent potential regions of interest (ROI).
Increase the Morph value to remove small objects using a morphological process with an n by n matrix.
Click Calculate button in the groupbox.
Repeat steps at least 5 times per each islet sample and use the average value to assess islet viability.
